user.title: Magmarium
user.description: Active volcanoes on a living globe. Choose the data sources and, optionally, volcanoes to watch (comma separated, e.g. Semeru, Merapi, Krakatau). Each watched volcano gets its own sensor.

data_description.sources: MAGMA Indonesia: official alert levels and VONA notices (ash clouds) for Indonesia. Weekly report: worldwide activity (Smithsonian / USGS). Official alert levels: USGS (US), Icelandic Met Office, JMA (Japan). Ash SIGMETs: official volcanic ash areas for aviation, worldwide. Earthquakes: USGS. Tsunami warnings: NOAA (PTWC, NTWC) and BMKG InaTEWS. Italy: Civil Protection alert levels, INGV VONA notices (Etna, Stromboli) and INGV earthquakes.
data_description.watched_volcanoes: Names as used by the sources, e.g. Semeru, Merapi, Anak Krakatau, Lewotobi, Etna.
data_description.places: Zones such as Home or your airports. Each gets a binary sensor that turns on when an ash cloud, an official ash area (SIGMET) or a simulated drift track comes within the radius.
data_description.ash_radius_km: Distance around each place, in km.
data_description.firms_map_key: Free key from firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key. With it, Magmarium shows satellite hotspots (thermal anomalies, VIIRS) at the summits of active volcanoes. Leave empty to switch this off.
data_description.fire_radius_km: Wildfires within this distance of your home location are shown on the globe and counted by the Wildfires sensor (needs the FIRMS key). 0 switches wildfires off, 20000 covers the whole world.

source_down.title: {source} is not reachable
source_down.description: Magmarium could not load data from {source} for more than {hours} hours. The last known data is still shown. Nothing needs to be done if the source is only temporarily down; the issue disappears on its own once the source answers again.
